emma: Quick flag 1: console's "version" chart shows a small, steady v2 slice but routing trace shows those reqs were pinned to redwood-v1. This is causing per-tenant quota spikes in the dashboard. Anyone familiar with the version attribution path?

ryan: we export two flavors: req.meta.client_version (from X-API-Version) and route.out.model (post-routing). console chart uses client_version for realtime agg.

priya: that mismatch sounds like the proxy header is set by SDK after retry, and routing service sometimes rewrites to a compatible variant (v1). we've seen this when model fallbacks happen.

dave: can you share an example trace id? i want to see the sequence: incoming header -> routing decision -> model execution -> billing event.

emma: trace tid=f5c8. snippet from trace-log: 
```
09:04:12.348 incoming header: X-API-Version=v2, req_id=f5c8
09:04:12.350 route_decision: tenant=900 model=redwood-v1 reason=fallback_seq_len
09:04:12.361 exec.start model=redwood-v1 req_id=f5c8
09:04:12.420 billing.emit tenant=900 model_tag=client:v2
```
Note billing.emit used client tag in the event.

ryan: aha. billing library currently defaults to the original client tag unless the router explicitly sets billed_model. router sets billed_model in 80% cases but not for some fastpath fallbacks.

priya: we should make billing event authoritative from route.out.model when present. Changing code path requires a careful rollout because downstream metering jobs consume billing events.

dave: rollout plan idea: 1) Add routed_model field to billing events (nullable) 2) Console and metering consumers prefer routed_model when present; otherwise use client_version. 3) Shadow-mode shipping: emit both old and new events and run comparison for 48h.

emma: + add a small console indicator: "attribution source: client_version / routed_model" toggle. we can default UI to show current (client_version) and let operators switch to routed_model view.

ryan: also add a top-level alert: if any tenant has >3% mismatch between old and new attribution for 1h window, pause automatic conversion and page revenue-ops.

priya: implementation note: routed_model is available in router event but sometimes arrives up to 5s after incoming event on high load. we need a join buffer in event pipeline keyed by req_id of ~10s. memory overhead modest if we limit to peak QPS.

dave: telemetry-bot, schedule perf test please: simulate 50k rps with 10% fallbacks and verify join-latency distribution.

telemetry-bot: perf-test 'attribution-join' scheduled for 2025-06-14T02:00Z, duration 1h. Results will be posted in #eng-platform.

emma: docs: update /docs/usage-attribution.md with new table mapping fields: client_version, routed_model, billed_model, and precedence rules. Also add runbook: how to reconcile and generate tenant delta reports.

ryan: reconciliation approach: re-process raw event batch for last 72h, recompute attributed counts using precedence routed_model > billed_model_field > client_version, emit delta CSV and a synthetic invoice preview (no real billing). ops review then decide write-back window.

priya: customer comms: draft e-mail to tenants with >1% projected change, include sample CSV and steps to dispute. keep it transparent.

dave: timeline check: PR for billing lib change + pipeline join by EOD, perf test overnight, shadow in prod for 1 cohort by 09:00 tomorrow.

emma: ok i'll own the UI toggle and docs, ryan take billing lib, priya handle comms, dave owns pipeline job. post PR links here.

emma: thanks all. small win: if we fix this, Console's "version" pie will finally reflect what actually ran and quota surprises should drop. :party-parrot:
